defs.meaning: 不赞成；不同意（disapprove 的过去式和过去分词）

examples.en: At the time, Arnold had disapproved of such levity.
examples.zh: 那时候，阿诺德不赞成如此的轻浮行为。

examples.en: I made it clear right from the outset that I disapproved.
examples.zh: 从一开始我就明确地说我不赞成。

examples.en: He strongly disapproved of the changes that had been made.
examples.zh: 他强烈反对已进行的变革。
